slow_witted.opening: You are slow off the mark mentally:
slow_witted.reply:
Both openings must lead straight into ": when a room has moved on to laughing, you are still piecing together why," so each should read as a statement about mental slowness that a colon can introduce.

For trait_first, I avoid "you are" and state the quality positively, as in "Your mind is slow off the mark". That keeps the original wording, begins with "Your", and describes what the person is like.

For a_person, I fit the original phrase into the "You are a ... person" frame, giving "You are a mentally slow-off-the-mark person". That is awkward, so "a slow-minded, slow-off-the-mark person" reads more naturally while keeping the meaning and the wording.

{"trait_first": "Your mind is slow off the mark", "a_person": "You are a mentally slow-off-the-mark person"}
